name: intent-verify
description: Catch intent drift: verify an AI change did what you actually asked, not what the diff claims.

plugins.name: intent-verify
plugins.description: Request-anchored, evidence-based drift verifier: criteria fixed before the code is read, then checked by running it. Controlled benchmark, 16 hand-built cases: recall 8/8, precision 8/8, 4/8 caught only by request-anchoring.
